commands: for f in skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md; do printf '%s  ' "$f"; sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1; done

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
git show HEAD:skills/implement/SKILL.md > "$tmp/SKILL.md"
git show HEAD:skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md > "$tmp/phase-1-setup.md"
cp .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1532/local-run/diff.patch "$tmp/d.patch"
cd "$tmp"
# Build a patch limited to the two skill files by applying full patch to a git repo copy is complex; instead apply with patch tool per-file using -p1 filtering
echo "tmpdir=$tmp"

mkdir -p /tmp/rev1532 && git show HEAD:skills/implement/SKILL.md > /tmp/rev1532/SKILL.md && git show HEAD:skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md > /tmp/rev1532/phase.md && git apply --include='skills/implement/SKILL.md' --include='skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md' --directory=/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---try apply in place on copies---"

D=/tmp/rev1532; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D/skills/implement/phases"; git show HEAD:skills/implement/SKILL.md > "$D/skills/implement/SKILL.md"; git show HEAD:skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md > "$D/skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md"; git show HEAD:scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json > "$D/contract.json"; ls -R "$D"

D=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$D/skills/implement/phases"; git show HEAD:skills/implement/SKILL.md > "$D/skills/implement/SKILL.md"; git show HEAD:skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md > "$D/skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md"; git apply -p1 --directory="$D" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1532/local-run/diff.patch --include='skills/implement/*' 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; sha256sum "$D/skills/implement/SKILL.md" "$D/skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md"
cp -r skills /tmp/base-skills 2>/dev/null; git apply --check .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1532/local-run/diff.patch && echo "PATCH APPLIES CLEANLY"

git apply .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1532/local-run/diff.patch && echo "APPLIED"; sha256sum skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md; git checkout -- . ; git stash drop 2>/dev/null; git status --porcelain | head
git apply .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1532/local-run/diff.patch; sha256sum skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md; git checkout -- skills

cd /tmp && rm -rf pr1532 && git -C /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow worktree add -q /tmp/pr1532 a10cd2af93e1c3732c50e9abc87b21806adc86fc 2>&1 | tail -2; sha256sum /tmp/pr1532/skills/implement/SKILL.md /tmp/pr1532/skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md

git worktree add -q /tmp/pr1532 a10cd2af93e1c3732c50e9abc87b21806adc86fc 2>&1 | tail -3; sha256sum /tmp/pr1532/skills/implement/SKILL.md /tmp/pr1532/skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md /tmp/pr1532/scripts/workpad.py

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
